title: Reset
prompt: Members `health` at 35 and `max_health` at 100. Write `reset`, which sets health back to max_health. solve calls reset and returns health, 100.
starter:
var health = 35
var max_health = 100

func solve():
	return health
hints: One member can be set from another.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.

solution:
var health = 35
var max_health = 100

func solve():
	reset()
	return health

func reset():
	health = max_health
